The product

One place for your clients, your calendar and your cash.

FlexPaid pulls together the three things every training business runs on — who you're training, when, and how they pay — and automates the money end from top to bottom. Here's what that looks like.

The calendar

Your week, colour-coded and self-driving

Recurring sessions drop onto your calendar automatically. As each one passes it marks itself complete, so the calendar is always up to date without you touching it — you only step in for the exceptions.

  • ✓ Auto-completed, confirmed, no-show, cancelled and gifted sessions each read at a glance.
  • ✓ A subtle "unpaid" flag appears only once a session is actually owed — never for future bookings.
  • ✓ Comp a session as a gift, or mark a no-show, in one tap.
app.flexpaid.com.au/calendar
The money view

Know exactly where every dollar goes

No mystery deductions. FlexPaid shows what you collected, the FlexPaid fee, Stripe's processing fee and the net that lands in your bank — laid out plainly, per payment and in total.

  • ✓ See who owes you and who's charging automatically, side by side.
  • ✓ The full fee waterfall: collected → FlexPaid fee → Stripe fee → net to you.
  • ✓ Live balance and next payout, pulled straight from Stripe.
app.flexpaid.com.au/money
Built for your pocket

Made for the gym floor, not the desk

Trainers don't sit at a computer. FlexPaid is a proper mobile app — a thumb-friendly tab bar, sessions you manage from a bottom sheet, and everything one tap away between sets.

  • ✓ Book, complete, comp or collect from your phone in seconds.
  • ✓ Pause a client for injury or holiday, then resume — billing stops and starts with them.
  • ✓ Works the same on desktop when you do sit down.
The client experience

A clean, trusted page for your clients

Your clients get a simple, branded page to set up payment — secured by Stripe, clear about what they're paying and when. No apps to download, no accounts to create.

  • ✓ One secure link, sent however you like — SMS, email, whatever.
  • ✓ Card or BECS direct debit, saved once and charged automatically.
  • ✓ Their plan, amount and status, always clear.
flexpaid.com.au/pay
